import_all_modules_in_directory: import all Python modules from a directory into a base module namespace using import_all_modules
import_all_packages_from_directory: automatically import all top-level packages from a directory using import_all_packages_from_directory
register_modules_for_registry: register all modules in a directory under a base module for use with a registry pattern
discover_and_import_packages: discover and import all packages in a root directory that have an __init__.py file
bulk_import_python_modules: bulk import Python modules from a directory path into sys.modules for lazy loading
